en.title: Dynamic Desktop
en.help: All monitors share this wallpaper. Theme changes keep it active; choosing an ordinary wallpaper pauses it.
en.preview_help: Duration follows the actual frame count × seconds per frame. Restores the previous wallpaper and mode when finished.
en.appearance_help: Appearance wallpapers have two states, so this previews light then dark.
